description: This PHP source file defines the Drupal FileUploadResource class, implementing a REST resource for uploading files at the field level within Drupal. It includes methods for creating files via POST requests, validating field definitions, and managing upload routes.

classes.name: FileUploadResource
classes.description: A Drupal REST resource class for handling file uploads at the field level, supporting creation via POST requests, validation, and route management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the resource with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: permissions
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no explicit permissions are required due to field-level access control.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload a file to a specified entity field, performing validation, file handling, and returning a response.

methods.name: validateAndLoadFieldDefinition
methods.description: Validates the specified entity type, bundle, and field name, ensuring the field exists, targets files, and the user has access.

methods.name: getBaseRoute
methods.description: Constructs a route object for the resource with specified path and method.

methods.name: getBaseRouteRequirements
methods.description: Defines route requirements, including content type restrictions.

methods.name: generateLockIdFromFileUri
methods.description: Generates a lock ID string based on the file URI, used for concurrency control.
